summary: Range Impact, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose its indirect subsidiary Range Sky View Land, LLC entering into an Operating Agreement with Time Complexity WV, LLC to form a 50/50 joint venture, Time Complexity Appalachia, LLC, for a power generation and data center project at the Fola mine site in West Virginia. Neither member is required to make initial cash capital contributions; future capital needs may be funded by member loans secured by JV assets on a pari passu basis. Management comprises a three-person board with each member appointing one manager and the third mutually agreed. This filing is not a traditional special situation (e.g., merger or acquisition), but rather a joint venture formation. Key watchpoints include project development milestones and debt structuring. No premium, price, or closing date disclosed.
